Aspera Connect — share with testers (Aug 2026)
==============================================

Branch: cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f

FULL GUIDE (Linux Mint Xfce):
  dist/release/BETA-TEST-LINUX-MINT.md
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/blob/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/BETA-TEST-LINUX-MINT.md

DESKTOP (Linux x64 — Mint, Ubuntu, Zorin, etc.)
  curl -L -o ~/.local/bin/aspera-connect \
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/aspera-connect-linux-x64"
  chmod +x ~/.local/bin/aspera-connect

  Mint Xfce clipboard: sudo apt install xclip
  KDE/Wayland clipboard: sudo apt install wl-clipboard

PHONE APK 0.3.6 (signed)
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk
  sha256: 2215e20113d55f540984a309381f3fa8ee27ad9e22e1b84f8f1184f2fc71147b

  adb: curl -L --http1.1 -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk "<url above>"
       adb install -t /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.6.apk

WHAT TESTERS NEED
  - Same office LAN; same Wi-Fi band if router splits 2.4/5 GHz
  - No Android Studio, no USB debugging for Easy mode
  - Favorites / Recents are desktop-only
